claims.text: DIA withheld the AAWSAP contract awarded to BAASS in a 2011 FOIA response and did not release it until October 2022.
Contract HHM402-08-C-0072, awarded 22 September 2008, firm fixed price, $10,000,000 base, to Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies LLC, DUNS 827037768, CAGE 54JU7.
All key government personnel names — contracting officer, COR and Government Project Leader — are redacted in the released contract under 10 USC 424.
DIA awarded the AAWSAP contract following solicitation HHM402-08-R-0211 and issued priced annual modifications, all released under FOIA.
The DIA released the AAWSAP contract file under FOIA case FOIA-00349-2018, producing the statement of work, contract modifications and the Defense Intelligence Reference Documents.
